purpose: Find actual same-physical-definition Goal alternatives for official Cosmos native best-of-N planning; no Cosmos forward or simulator run
canonicalization_limits: Exact canonical parsed equality is sufficient for this metadata criterion, not necessary for semantic physical equivalence; list ordering is intentionally preserved, matching prior audit.
scope_limits: Removing language_instruction, goal_state and obj_of_interest compares declared physical scene and initialization predicates only.

Identical BDDL physical definitions do not mean identical sampled or recorded simulator states. Separate .pruned_init files must not be interchanged; fix the original environment, original init file/index, settled state and controls when changing only world-branch text.
File-byte hashes are provenance and do not establish numerical init-state equality; this audit does not load or replay saved state vectors.
A same-scene goal can still carry valid hidden-state information under partial observations in the training distribution; metadata equality alone does not prove observation-level goal independence.
Benchmark language is derived from task filename by the official benchmark; it can differ from BDDL :language wording. Both are recorded.
